name: fluent-bit-system-teardown
description: Card SELECTION-ROUTES-SPLIT-CALLER-AND-HOME: the eight files of the fluent-bit-system selection (system-selection.json, unchanged) plus every Fluent Bit source file that calls one of the released-element drain homes named by LERI-CROSS-UNIT-ELEMENTS-RELEASED (flb_engine_destroy_tasks, flb_storage_input_destroy, flb_output_exit, flb_sched_timer_cleanup, flb_task_retry_clean, flb_sched_destroy) from another file: src/flb_input.c (flb_input_instance_destroy, flb_input_instance_exit), src/flb_input_thread.c and src/flb_output_thread.c (the scheduler drains of the thread loops) and src/flb_config.c (flb_config_exit). So rule 40 can resolve each drain's cross-unit callers to its home in one route. Every distinct compilation configuration is kept, as in the system selection. Measured under a rule 40 link-resolution artifact; this is no live evaluation profile, and it changes neither the system selection nor the profile's audit.json 185-unit selection.
